svg.title: Winner of each game by seed block and rotation, one panel per configured agent
svg.desc: Filled cells mark games won by the panel's agent. Every cell shows that agent's seat (1-4) in that game. Twenty games, five shared-dice seed blocks, four cyclic rotations.

g.text: Who won each game: five seed blocks × four cyclic rotations
Filled cell = that agent won. Label = that agent's seat in the game (seat 1 moves first).
Rows share raw dice streams; opportunities still diverge after the first differing decision.

g.text: Wins by winner's seat: seat 1: 7, seat 2: 7, seat 3: 3, seat 4: 3. Columns r0–r3 = rotations within a block.
Reference i.i.d. uniform nulls (ignore block dependence): P(prespecified agent ≥ 8/20) = 0.10;
P(any agent ≥ 8/20) = 0.40; P(seat 1 or 2 wins ≥ 14/20) = 0.058. No ranking or seat effect is established.
